# Gong

Gong is a platform for video meetings, call recording, and team collaboration.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gong/.

## Actions

- **Retrieve call data by date range  v2 calls** (read-only): List calls that took place during a specified date range.
- **Add call media  v2 calls id media**: Adds a call media, recorded by a telephony system (pbx) or other media recording facility.
- **Add new call  v2 calls**: When using this endpoint, either provide a downloadmediaurl or use the returned callid in a follow-up request to /v2/calls/{id}/media to…
- **Aggregate activity by period via api** (read-only): Lists the aggregated activity of multiple users within the gong system for each time period within the defined date range.
- **Aggregate user activity statistics** (read-only): Lists the activity of multiple users within the gong system during a defined period.
- **Assign prospects to flow**: Use this endpoint to assign a number of prospects to a flow.
- **Create a new gong meeting  v2 meetings**: When accessed through a bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api.
- **Create activity scorecards report** (read-only): Retrieve all the answers for the scorecards that were reviewed during a specified date range, for calls that took place during a specified…
- **Create permission profile  v2 permission profile**: Create a permission profile in a given workspace.
- **Data privacy for phone number** (read-only): Shows the elements in the gong system that reference the given phone number.
- **Delete a generic crm integration  v2 crm integrations**: Deletes an existing crm integration from the gong platform.
- **Delete a gong meeting  v2 meetings**: When accessed through a bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api.
- **Delete users from call access list**: Remove individual user access from calls.
- **Erase data for email address**: Given an email address, this endpoint deletes from the gong system any calls or email messages that reference this address.
- **Erase data for phone number**: Given a phone number, this endpoint deletes from the gong system any leads or contacts with a matching phone number or mobile phone number.
- **Fetch all permission profiles** (read-only): Returns a list of all permission profiles.
- **Get Crm Integration Details** (read-only): <style>.public-api-info { background.
- **Get crm objects  v2 crm entities** (read-only): Retrieves crm entities from the gong platform.
- **Get permission profile** (read-only): Returns a permission profile.
- **Get request status  v2 crm request status** (read-only): The getcrmrequeststatus endpoint retrieves the current status of crm integration requests in the gong platform.
- **List all coaching metrics  v2 coaching** (read-only): List all of the coaching metrics of a manager.
- **List all company workspaces  v2 workspaces** (read-only): Returns a list of all workspaces including their details.
- **List all users  v2 users** (read-only): List all of the company's users.
- **List flows for crm prospects** (read-only): Get the gong engage flows assigned to the given prospects.
- **List Folder Calls** (read-only): Given a folder id, this endpoint retrieves a list of calls in it.
- **List gong engage flows  v2 flows** (read-only): Engage flows have the following visibility types.
- **List schema fields  v2 crm entity schema** (read-only): Retrieves the comprehensive schema of crm entities in the gong platform.
- **List users by filter  v2 users extensive** (read-only): List multiple users.
- **Manage user call access** (read-only): Returns a list of users who have received individual access to calls through the api.
- **Post a digital interaction  v2 digital interaction**: When accessed through a bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api.
- **Post day by day activity stats** (read-only): Retrieve the daily activity of multiple users within the gong system for a range of dates.
- **Post interaction filter stats** (read-only): Returns interaction stats for users based on calls that have whisper turned on.
- **Post meeting integration status** (read-only): When accessed through a bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api.
- **Register Crm Integration**: Updates an existing crm integration in the gong platform.
- **Report content viewed event**: Push engagement events into gong and display them as events in gong’s activity timeline, when a content is viewed by an external…
- **Report Custom Engagement Event**: Push engagement events into gong and display them as events in gong’s activity timeline, when a content is engaged by an external…
- **Retrieve data for a specific call  v2 calls id** (read-only): Retrieve data for a specific call.
- **Retrieve data privacy info for email address** (read-only): Shows the elements in the gong system that reference the given email address.
- **Retrieve filtered call details** (read-only): Lists detailed call data for calls that took place during a specified date range, have specified call ids or hosted by specified users.
- **Retrieve library folders  v2 library folders** (read-only): Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of public library folders.
- **Retrieve logs data by type and time range  v2 logs** (read-only): List log entries that took place during a specified time range.
- **Retrieve manual crm call associations** (read-only): Returns a list of all calls that were manually associated or re-associated with crm account and deal/opportunity since a given time.
- **Retrieve scorecards details  v2 settings scorecards** (read-only): Retrieve all the scorecards within the gong system.
- **Retrieve tracker details  v2 settings trackers** (read-only): Retrieves details of all keyword trackers in the system or in a given workspace.
- **Retrieve transcripts of calls  v2 calls transcript** (read-only): Returns transcripts for calls that took place during the specified date period.
- **Retrieve user  v2 users id** (read-only): Retrieve a specific user.
- **Retrieve User Settings History** (read-only): Retrieve a specific user's settings history.
- **Retrieve users from permission profile** (read-only): Returns a list of all users whose access is controlled by the given permission profile.
- **Set User Call Access**: Give individual users access to calls.
- **Update a gong meeting  v2 meetings meetingid**: When accessed through a bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api.
- **Update permission profile  v2 permission profile**: Update a permission profile.
- **Update shared content event**: Push engagement events into gong and display them as events in gong’s activity timeline, when a gong user shares content with external…
- **Upload crm objects  v2 crm entities**: Uploads crm data files to the gong platform for integration and analysis.
